steps.name: input
steps.description: Input atoms: model 1, heavy atoms, all altlocs.

steps.name: altloc_highest_occupancy
steps.description: Keep each residue's highest-occupancy alternate conformer.

steps.name: atomworks_parse
steps.description: AtomWorks parse: hydrogens removed, missing atoms added, names standardised.

steps.name: remove_small_polymers
steps.description: Remove polymer chains of 3 or fewer residues.

steps.name: remove_fully_unknown_polymers
steps.description: Remove polymers made only of unknown residues.

steps.name: remove_clashing_chains
steps.description: Remove chains that clash with others.

steps.name: remove_non_CCD_atoms
steps.description: Remove atoms not in the CCD definition of their residue.

steps.name: remove_chains_with_CA_gaps
steps.description: Remove polymer chains with CA-CA gaps over 10 A.

steps.name: prefilter_bonds
steps.description: Drop disallowed bonds (inter-chain dative/polymer links, longer than 2.4 A).

steps.name: remove_terminal_atoms
steps.description: Remove OXT/OP3 terminal atoms of standard residues.
